label: Metric-calibrated indicator

design.change: Supervise the indicator head with the matched query's true IoU instead of a hard 0/1 label.
design.rationale: The B0 diagnostic showed a large oracle gap caused by ranking. This keeps the strong standard mask generator and directly calibrates the ranking target to the evaluation metric.
design.fallback: If the calibration does not improve top-1 mIoU, do not tune its coefficient; return to the standard indicator.
